query: This Dependabot PR bumps grpc but go.mod changed eight lines. Why did the other modules move?
expected_behavior: Finds the merge base with git merge-base and runs whybumped with --base and the module directory
Passes the module and version from the PR title with --expect
Groups the other changes by the root module in the 'pulled in through' line and names the requirer of each
Treats exit code 2 as unknown and shows the error instead of calling it a pass

query: After I added a dependency, go.mod now says go 1.23 and CI on Go 1.22 broke. Which dependency did that?
expected_behavior: Runs whybumped with --base set to the commit before the change
Reports the go-raised finding: the dependency that needs the new go version and the chain back to go.mod
Says whether go.mod went further than any dependency needs

query: Did my go get -u change anything that nothing needs?
expected_behavior: Runs whybumped against the commit before the go get
Lists requested changes on // indirect modules that no dependency needs, with the highest version dependencies need
